underlyingAsset: Zimbabwe state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility

description: ZESA Holdings tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.

tokenName: ZESA Holdings Capital Project Milestone Token

description: ZESA Holdings tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 USD unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.

description: ZESA Holdings tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
